post.description:
Step 1 of signing in, from the phone number screen of every app: the customer app sends `audience: customer`, the vendor, kitchen and admin dashboards their own audience. The code arrives by SMS (in the language of `Accept-Language`, Arabic by default); the app then shows the code screen and calls `POST /v1/public/auth/otp/verify` with the same phone and audience.

The answer is the same whether or not the phone may sign in to a staff audience (vendor, kitchen, admin): a phone without that access gets the same 200 but no SMS, and any code it sends is then refused as OTP_INVALID. A new code replaces the previous one, which stops working. Phones set up for app-store review receive no SMS and sign in with the fixed code given to the reviewer.

Errors:
- RATE_LIMITED (429, `Retry-After` in seconds): asked again before `resendAfterSeconds` passed, too many codes for this phone and audience (3 per 10 minutes by default; customers also 10 per day), or too many requests from this network address. Show a countdown from `Retry-After`.
- SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE (503): the SMS could not be sent, or the limits cannot be checked right now. No code was sent; the user may try again shortly.

200.description: The code was issued (or the request was answered as if it had been): show the code screen.

post.description:
Step 2 of signing in, from the code screen of every app: exchanges the code sent by `POST /v1/public/auth/otp/request` for an access token and a refresh token of that one audience. Only the newest code of the phone and audience works, once, before it expires, and for a limited number of attempts (5 by default). A customer signing in for the first time gets a new account; staff need access granted by an admin.

Keep the refresh token in secure storage and send the access token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. For a customer, `profileComplete` false means the app may show the profile completion screen (skippable).

Errors:
- OTP_INVALID (422): the code is wrong, or the phone has no access to this staff audience. The attempt is counted; let the user retype it.
- OTP_EXPIRED (410): no code can be verified any more (none requested, expired, already used, or attempts used up). Ask for a new code.
- ACCOUNT_DISABLED (403): the account is disabled; signing in again will not help (contact support).
- VENDOR_SUSPENDED (403): vendor sign-in only; the store is suspended until an admin reinstates it.
- TRANSACTION_CONFLICT (409): a rare clash with another change to the same account; send the same request again.
- RATE_LIMITED (429): too many attempts from this network address; wait `Retry-After` seconds.
- SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE (503): the limits cannot be checked or the database cannot be reached right now; retry shortly.

post.description:
Called by every app when a request answers 401 ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRED (or shortly before the access token expires): returns a new access token and a new refresh token for the same session. Store the new refresh token at once: each refresh token works once, and presenting a used one again ends the session for every holder. If the answer to a refresh is lost, the user signs in again, so send one refresh at a time per session.

Errors:
- REFRESH_TOKEN_INVALID (401): unknown, expired or already used token, or the session has ended (signed out, account deleted, staff access removed). Go to the sign-in screen; do not retry.
- ACCOUNT_DISABLED (403): the account is disabled and the session has ended; show the support message.
- VENDOR_SUSPENDED (403): vendor sessions only; the store is suspended and the session has ended.
- TRANSACTION_CONFLICT (409): a rare clash with another change to the same session; send the same request again.
- SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE (503): the database cannot be reached; retry shortly with the same refresh token.

post.description:
Called by the customer app when a customer applying to sell on the platform attaches the documents of the vendor application. The confirmed ids go in the application `documents[].mediaId`.

Step 1 of 3 of a file upload. The file never passes through this API: this returns a ticket for a direct upload to storage.

1. Call this with the purpose, the file Content-Type and, optionally, its name. Nothing is uploaded yet.
2. Before `expiresAt` (5 minutes after the request by default), send `POST` to `url` as `multipart/form-data`: first one text part for every entry of `fields`, name and value exactly as given (add none, change none), then the file itself as the **last** part, named `file`. Send no Authorization header to the storage. The storage answers 204 with no body when it stored the file. It refuses an empty file, a file larger than the purpose allows, a changed field or an expired ticket with an error status (4xx) and an XML body of its own, not this API error format. Until `expiresAt` the same ticket can be used again (after a network failure): the last upload replaces the earlier one.
3. Only after the storage answered 204, and before `confirmBy` (1 hour after the request by default), confirm the file: `POST .../media/{mediaId}/confirm`. Only a confirmed file can be used, and only by the user who uploaded it.

Read both times from the response: they are server settings and may change.

Limits: 30 ticket requests a minute per client address and 100 an hour per user; over them, 429 RATE_LIMITED with Retry-After.

Errors:
- MEDIA_CONTENT_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED (415): the purpose does not accept this `contentType`; `details.allowed` lists the types it accepts. Nothing was created.
- VALIDATION_FAILED (400): a purpose this app may not upload, or a missing or too long `contentType` or `fileName`.
- SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE (503): the storage or the database cannot be reached, or the upload limits cannot be counted right now (uploads are then refused). Nothing was created; try again shortly.

Purposes accepted here (accepted types; size; who can read the file):
- `vendor.document`: application/pdf, image/jpeg, image/png; 1 byte to 10 MiB (10485760 bytes); private (read only through a short-lived link from the API).

post.description:
Step 3 of a file upload: call it once the storage answered 204 to the upload, before the ticket `confirmBy`. The path id is the ticket `mediaId`.

The API checks the uploaded file: present, not empty, not larger than the purpose allows, its real type (read from the file first bytes) one the purpose accepts and equal to the `contentType` declared for the ticket. A file that passes is ready: give its `id` to the endpoint that uses it (a product `imageMediaIds`, the vendor `logoMediaId` or `coverMediaId`, the documents of a vendor application). A file that fails is deleted for good: request a new ticket and upload again. Confirming before the upload finished therefore rejects the file (OBJECT_MISSING).

Idempotent: confirming a ready file again returns it again; a rejected file answers the same MEDIA_UPLOAD_REJECTED again. Only the user who requested the ticket can confirm it.

Limit: 60 confirmations a minute per client address; over it, 429 RATE_LIMITED with Retry-After.

Errors:
- MEDIA_NOT_FOUND (404): no such file for this user: an unknown id, a file another user uploaded, or an unconfirmed upload already removed after its `confirmBy`.
- MEDIA_UPLOAD_EXPIRED (410): `confirmBy` has passed. Request a new ticket and upload again.
- MEDIA_UPLOAD_REJECTED (422): the file failed a check and was deleted. `details.reason`: OBJECT_MISSING (nothing was uploaded with the ticket), EMPTY_FILE, TOO_LARGE, TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED (the content is none of the accepted types), CONTENT_TYPE_MISMATCH (the content is another type than the declared `contentType`, a PNG declared as image/jpeg for example), or OWNER_DELETED (the account was deleted).
- VALIDATION_FAILED (400): the id is not a UUID.
- SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE (503): the storage or the database cannot be reached, or the limit cannot be counted right now. Confirm again shortly, before `confirmBy`.

parameters.description: The id (a UUID) of the item the path names; another value is VALIDATION_FAILED on `id`.

post.description: Customer app, checkout "place order". Checks the cart again, then in one transaction: reserves the day’s capacity, uses the coupon, takes the wallet part, creates the order (`pending_payment`, or `new`/`confirmed` for cash on delivery and wallet only) and its payment attempt, and empties the cart. Open `payment.nextAction.redirectUrl` when it is not null; an unpaid order is cancelled after 15 minutes (`order.expiresAt`), giving back the capacity, the coupon and the wallet part. Refusals send the customer back: to the cart for CART_EMPTY, PRICE_CHANGED and ITEM_UNAVAILABLE (`details.lineIds`), MIN_ORDER_NOT_MET (`details.minOrderHalalas`, `details.remainingHalalas`) and the coupon codes; to the fulfilment step for FULFILMENT_REQUIRED, ADDRESS_NOT_COVERED, DAY_FULL and DAY_NOT_AVAILABLE; to the payment step for PAYMENT_METHOD_NOT_AVAILABLE and WALLET_INSUFFICIENT; to the profile for PROFILE_INCOMPLETE (no full name). ORDERING_PAUSED while orders are paused (`details.messageAr`, `details.messageEn`: the admin’s message). Sprint 3 takes cash on delivery only (`paymentMethod: cod`, no wallet part): another method is PAYMENT_METHOD_NOT_AVAILABLE and a wallet part WALLET_INSUFFICIENT. The order starts `new` and `payment` is null (no payment record for cash). A line that can no longer be ordered, or whose price moved since it was accepted, is ITEM_UNAVAILABLE or PRICE_CHANGED with `details.lineIds`; nothing is charged at a price the customer did not see. totalDiscountHalalas.description: What it took off in all, in halalas.

balanceHalalas.description: The balance, in halalas; never below 0. The wallet part of an unpaid order past its `expiresAt` is already back in it.

amountHalalas.description: How much, in halalas: positive added, negative taken.

balanceAfterHalalas.description: The balance after it, in halalas.

orderId.description: The order it is about; null for an admin adjustment.

note.description: The admin’s reason for an adjustment; null otherwise.

items.description: The movements on this page.

nextCursor.description: Send as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last.

reason.description: Why, kept in the audit log and shown in the history; 3 to 500 characters.

received.description: Always true: the event was recorded (a repeat of an event already processed changes nothing).

isAvailable.description: Whether it can be chosen; `false`: shown disabled with `reason`.

reason.description: Why not, when `isAvailable` is false; null otherwise.

window.description: The delivery window (delivery) or the store’s hours that day (pickup); null when unavailable.

items.description: The days, today first.

isAvailable.description: Whether it can be chosen now; `false`: shown disabled with `reason`.

reason.description: Why not, when not available; null otherwise.

items.description: The methods, in display order. Cash on delivery is left out when it is off, over its limit or not allowed for the order type.

walletBalanceHalalas.description: The customer’s wallet balance, in halalas; any part of it can pay with another method.

totalHalalas.description: The total these methods are for, in halalas.

walletAmountHalalas.description: Part of the total to take from the wallet with another method, in halalas, 0 to less than the total; left out: 0. With `wallet` leave it out: the whole total is taken. More than the balance: WALLET_INSUFFICIENT.

redirectUrl.description: The hosted payment page to open. On staging the fake provider’s page (approve or decline); never build or change it.

returnUrl.description: Where the page sends the customer when done: close the web view on this scheme, host and path (any query), then poll GET /v1/customer/orders/{id}.

amountHalalas.description: How much this attempt charges, in halalas (the order total less the wallet part).

nextAction.description: What the app does next; null when nothing is paid online (cash on delivery, wallet only) or the payment is no longer `initiated`.

order.description: The order as it is now.

payment.description: The payment attempt; null when nothing is paid online (cash on delivery, wallet only): no payment record is made.

walletAmountHalalas.description: Part of the total to take from the wallet with another method, in halalas, 0 to less than the total; left out: 0. With `wallet` leave it out: the whole total is taken. More than the balance: WALLET_INSUFFICIENT.

notes.description: A note on the order for the store, up to 500 characters.
